name: plugin-updater
description: Keeps every installed Claude Code plugin current in every scope (user, project, local) and every project folder. At session start, once a day by default, it runs the updater detached: refreshes the marketplaces and runs claude plugin update one install at a time for each install behind its marketplace clone; the next session shows one line with what changed or needs you. /plugin-updater:update-plugins runs it on demand, --dry-run lists only, --last shows the last background run. It never accepts a changed marketplace command, and skips missing folders and git worktrees. Each switch is a /config option.

cc_plugin_updater_auto.title: Update in the background (CC_PLUGIN_UPDATER_AUTO)
cc_plugin_updater_auto.description: At session start, when the last completed run is older than the interval, run the updater detached and report it at the next session start: on or off. Off leaves only a startup line counting outdated installs. The environment variable CC_PLUGIN_UPDATER_AUTO overrides this.

cc_plugin_updater_interval.title: Hours between background runs (CC_PLUGIN_UPDATER_INTERVAL)
cc_plugin_updater_interval.description: Minimum hours from the last completed run to the next background run; 0 runs at every session start. The environment variable CC_PLUGIN_UPDATER_INTERVAL overrides this.

cc_plugin_updater_hint.title: Outdated-installs line (CC_PLUGIN_UPDATER_HINT)
cc_plugin_updater_hint.description: With background updates off, show a startup line counting outdated plugin installs: on or off. The environment variable CC_PLUGIN_UPDATER_HINT overrides this.
